thresholds.rule: Negative TTM operating cash flow and cash runway below six months.
Completed equity-linked financing publicly disclosed in the preceding 60 calendar days, with independently reconciled issuance/security class.
Previous distinct reverse split effective no more than 180 calendar days before the current split.
At least 25% growth in split-adjusted end-of-period common shares over the preceding six months.
Completed effective-day close below its open and in the bottom quarter of the day's high-low range.
Mechanically adjusted close-to-close return over the last 20 completed sessions at or below -20%.
Skip if any mechanically adjusted close-to-close rise in the last five completed sessions was at least 50%.

enrollment: Manual only; source/issuer bindings, independent reviews where required and timestamped broker evidence. No scheduler or order route.
